title: Mirabel and the Summit
author: Ivo Sandoval
blurb: Dominic Hartwell, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, has spent ten years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
